text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hey... Sorry for losing like that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But now isn't the time to mope.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
After all, I can't enjoy my post-race meal
if I'm
down in the dumps.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
After all, I can't enjoy my post-race meal
if I'm
down in the dumps.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I won't let you down again...
Hm?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I just got a message from the folks back
home.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"What a great race. You'll get 'em next
time!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Next time, I wanna get first place and
do them
all proud!

The message from home seems to have
given
Oguri Cap a renewed
determination to win.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sounds good! Don't hold back on me!

With Oguri Cap full of determination,
we throw
ourselves into an impromptu
training session.
